name: db-explorer
description: Read-only MySQL and PostgreSQL explorer for web and desktop
author: DB Explorer

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @db-explorer/shared && concurrently -k "npm run dev -w @db-explorer/backend" "npm run dev -w @db-explorer/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @db-explorer/shared && npm run build -w @db-explorer/backend && npm run build -w @db-explorer/frontend && node scripts/bundle.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @db-explorer/shared && npm run typecheck -w @db-explorer/backend && npm run typecheck -w @db-explorer/frontend
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.test:fixtures: node scripts/test-certificates.mjs && docker compose -f compose.test.yaml up -d --wait --wait-timeout 180
